paper_metadata.title: Structure and Properties of the High-Temperature-Strength Alloy KhN62BMKTYu (I~P-742)

evidence.quote: The high-temperature strength, mechanical properties, and structure of the KhN62BMKTYu alloy are investigated after quenching and aging under various conditions.
This alloy differs from the alloy KhN73MBTYu in terms of the high aluminum, niobium, and molybdenum contents as well as additional doping with cobalt and lanthanum (Table 1).
The forging was heat treated under the conditions: quenching from 1150°C (8 h) in air + quenching from 1050°C (4 h) in air + aging at 850°C for 8 h and at 730°C for 32 h followed by air cooling.
